body: Chief opened the RecallGraph construction-boundary P1 and explicitly asked coordination with you. I have not claimed or edited it. Current-main audit finds 17 direct RecallGraph constructions: four production paths beyond codec, plus laws and broad tests. A private plain class with validated raw fields is the narrowest public seal, but it forces RecallSegmenter.segment and InterviewSegmenter.segment either to return a typed error or to introduce an internal bypass; a phantom Draft to Checked design is broader and still unsafe if downstream APIs accept unknown status. My provisional preference is private plain class plus one public accumulating smart constructor over raw fields, no unsafe package factory, and honest error propagation from segmenters. The codec checksum foil that copies text into an incoherent graph must then become wire tampering or a different valid recall, as the chief notes. Please send your text-at-span and current fixture constraints, preferred boundary shape, and any live branch overlap before I propose paths or claim.
